context: Evaluates understanding of spprof's Profile, Sample, and Frame data model. The candidate must correctly traverse Profile.samples, access Sample fields (timestamp_ns, thread_id, thread_name, frames), and navigate Frame attributes (function_name, filename, lineno, is_native).

checklist.name: Profile top-level fields
checklist.description: Accesses and prints profile.sample_count, profile.total_duration_ms, profile.effective_rate_hz, profile.dropped_count, profile.python_version, and profile.platform.

checklist.name: Iterates profile.samples
checklist.description: Iterates over profile.samples (list of Sample objects) or accesses profile.samples[0].

checklist.name: Sample field access
checklist.description: Reads sample.thread_id and sample.frames from at least one Sample object.

checklist.name: Frame attribute access
checklist.description: Reads frame.function_name, frame.filename, frame.lineno from at least one Frame in a sample's frames list.

checklist.name: Frame.is_native boolean check
checklist.description: Accesses frame.is_native and confirms it is a boolean value.
